text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Screenshots collection stores gameplay images captured while using Batocera. These images provide a visual record of games played across every supported system and can be browsed directly from the frontend. Screenshots are saved at the game's native output resolution, making them a convenient way to preserve memorable moments and build a personal gallery.
